# The Numbers Game

> The Numbers Game is a weekly Australian podcast about finance, investment and business, hosted by accountant Jason Robinson and financial planner Nick Reilly. Each episode has its own page with the video and show notes; many also have chapters and a transcript.

## URL pattern
- Home: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/
- Every episode (searchable list): https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/episodes
- One episode: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/<episode-slug> (no trailing slash, no .html), e.g. https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/victoria-ranked-most-mismanaged-in-the-west
- Old links of the form https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/episodes/<slug> (from the previous Simplecast site) redirect to https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/<slug>
- About the show: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/about
- Hosts: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/nick-reilly and https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/jason-robinson
- Find moments inside episodes: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/adventure
- Contact: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/contact
- Sitemap: https://thenumbersgamepodcast.com.au/sitemap.xml
- Podcast RSS feed: https://feeds.simplecast.com/1EHEYhtl
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@thenumbersgamepodcast
- Spotify: https://open.spotify.com/show/41SVe1eJhucikhF3fWD3NW
- Apple Podcasts: https://podcasts.apple.com/au/podcast/id1555566088

The Numbers Game provides general information only and does not take into account your personal objectives, financial situation or needs.
